conviction_note: Two-sided: the public backlog-conversion arithmetic (25-30% of $1.76B = $440-530M H2 vs ~$507M needed for the $900M low end, Street ~$921M) plus a peer revenue miss on order timing argue for a guide trimmed to the low end, while Q3 bookings (AMDT3 18 platforms, >$600M GEO order, $300M QTD by Aug 13, two IM 300s, CLPS 2 selection) should lift backlog, a peer (RKLB) printed record backlog after LUNR last spoke, and 22% of shares out are short with calls bid; the findings sum to about +1.0 but the stock is +24% in five sessions into the print, so p_up sits at 50 and the scaled number is 0 while abs_move stays at the option-implied ~11.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue consensus ~$243-248M (Finviz/Zacks preview $243.3M, https://finviz.com/news/416018/intuitive-machines-must-prove-its-18-billion-backlog-can-turn-into-revenue-and-profit ; TipRanks $245.9M with B. Riley at $252M, https://www.tipranks.com/news/intuitive-machines-stock-lunr-what-options-traders-expect ; Yahoo range $235-260.5M); EPS -$0.10 to -$0.12; consensus Q3 adj. EBITDA ~$4.1M (B. Riley $2.2M). Company guide FY26 revenue $900M-$1B and positive adj. EBITDA (reaffirmed 2026-08-13); FY Street ~$920-921M near the low end. Two agreeing estimate sources plus a company guide, so the bar is sourced.
positioning_check: Short interest 36,147,660 shares at the 2026-10-30 settlement, 22.39% of shares outstanding (higher as % of float), days to cover 6.07, down 5.0% from 38.04M on 2026-10-15 (https://altindex.com/ticker/lunr/short-interest, read 2026-11-11). Skew_25d = -10.25 vol points (calls bid over puts, 'upside paid'), put/call OI 0.5, ATM IV 179.5%, event-implied move 10.65% (straddle 13.1%; TipRanks quotes ~15.3%). Stock +24.2% in 5 sessions (Nov 6 +21% to $10.47 on bargain hunting; Nov 9 ~+15% on NASA CLPS 2 selection) and +11.9% over 20 sessions, but -73% from the 52-week high. Crowded short plus call-side skew: a negative needs to be shrunk; the 5-day run-up means part of the squeeze has already happened before the print. Stocktwits retail sentiment flipped bearish on Nov 3.

findings.finding: The company's own conversion guide does not reach its revenue guide: at Q2 management said 25-30% of the $1.76B June-30 backlog converts in 2026, i.e. ~$440-530M for H2, while H1 revenue was ~$393M so the $900M low end needs ~$507M in H2 and Street FY ~$921M needs ~$528M (Q4 ~$285M after a ~$243M Q3); management tied the midpoint/high end to contract definitization and procurement timing, and in early November KeyBanc cut its target citing 'delays in contract awards'. A guide narrowed to the low end or trimmed below $900M is the most likely guidance outcome; reaffirmation would read positive.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-08-13 the company missed revenue ($206.2M vs ~$212-221M) but reaffirmed the $900M-$1B guide and the stock moved +3.6% close-to-close (baseline); on 2025-11-04 the print moved -10.19%; the large positive reactions (+22.4% 2025-05-13, +30.0% 2025-03-24) came with guidance/backlog news. Guidance has been the line this name trades on.
findings.why_not_priced: The arithmetic is public (TIKR, Finviz/Zacks preview), and the stock already sits ~73% off its high, so part of a low-end narrowing is in the price; but Street FY consensus at ~$921M still sits ABOVE the low end and the company has not changed the guide, so a cut below $900M is not in consensus. If the market fully expected a cut, FY consensus would sit below $900M and the skew would not be paying for calls.
findings.independence: Same backlog-conversion math in the Finviz/Zacks preview (https://finviz.com/news/416018/intuitive-machines-must-prove-its-18-billion-backlog-can-turn-into-revenue-and-profit, 2026-11-04) - one underlying company statement, counted once. KeyBanc 'delays in contract awards' via TipRanks (https://www.tipranks.com/news/intuitive-machines-stock-lunr-what-options-traders-expect, 2026-11-09) is a separate source pointing the same way.

findings.finding: Q3 bookings should push backlog well above the $1.8B record: $300M was already awarded quarter-to-date by Aug 13, the 18-platform AMDT3/Golden Dome order via L3Harris landed in July, a >$600M three-satellite GEO commercial order (IM 1300) was announced mid-August, two IM 300 platforms for a new customer were booked Sept 1, and an IM 300 for NASA EAGLE-VSWIR came in August; B. Riley says bookings matter more than the quarter and expects backlog to grow from $1.8B.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 (2026-08-13) backlog jumped 67% to a record $1.8B on $920M bookings and the stock moved only +3.6% close-to-close (-1.95% on the day per Benzinga) because revenue missed: backlog has been bought weakly when revenue disappoints.
findings.why_not_priced: Each award was announced, so the direction is priced; the size of the Q3 backlog number is not, because the AMDT3 and GEO orders were undisclosed or 'more than' values and no Q3 backlog estimate exists in any preview. If the market had priced a ~$2.3B+ backlog the stock would not be at 7x the B. Riley FY27 sales multiple compression it is (targets cut to $34/$30).
findings.independence: IM 300 two-platform order (https://finviz.com/news/387357/intuitive-machines-books-order-for-two-im-300-platforms-from-new-customer, 2026-09-01); B. Riley bookings view via TipRanks (https://www.tipranks.com/news/intuitive-machines-stock-lunr-what-options-traders-expect, 2026-11-09).

findings.finding: Rocket Lab, the closest listed space-systems peer, reported Q3 on 2026-11-09 (after LUNR last spoke in August) with record revenue $267.8M (+73% y/y), backlog +$1.2B or +52% q/q to a record $3.57B, positive GAAP operating cash flow and a guide to record Q4 revenue and margin - evidence that government/defense space awards were converting into bookings in the quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured LUNR reaction to peer prints; LUNR rose ~15% on 2026-11-09 mostly on the CLPS 2 selection the same day, so the peer read-across is partly in the 5-day run-up.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced in the +24% five-day move; it is a proxy, not a LUNR number, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Proxy only; L3Harris Q3 (2026-10-29) booked a $955M AMDT3 award per secondary coverage (https://finviz.com/news/411150/l3harris-delivers-record-backlog-and-strong-third-quarter-results), but its own release names no space award and shows Space & Mission Systems book-to-bill of only 1.0x, so that counterparty is neutral.

findings.finding: Redwire, a smaller space-systems peer, reported Q3 on 2026-11-04 with revenue $109.0M against ~$126-136M expected, blamed uneven order timing and delayed defense shipments, and fell ~20.8% on Nov 5 despite record backlog ($619.7M, book-to-bill 1.73) and reaffirmed guidance: the market punished a revenue miss in this group even with record backlog.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: LUNR's own Q2 had the same shape (revenue miss, record backlog) and moved +3.6% close-to-close, so this group's reaction function is not uniform.
findings.why_not_priced: LUNR has since rallied 24%, so the market is not extrapolating Redwire's timing problems to LUNR; if it were, LUNR's skew would not be call-side.
findings.independence: Redwire's own Q3 release (https://finviz.com/news/416076/redwire-corporation-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results-expands-backlog-achieves-record-gross-margins) and StockStory's 'misses Q3 revenue estimates' (https://stockstory.org/us/stocks/nyse/rdw/news/earnings/redwire-nyserdw-misses-q3-2026-revenue-estimates). Proxy for LUNR.

findings.finding: Positioning: 36.1M shares short (22.4% of shares outstanding, 6.07 days to cover at the 2026-10-30 settlement), call-side skew of -10.25 vol points and put/call OI 0.5 - a crowded short into a print where any reaffirmation of guide or large backlog figure has a squeeze mechanism, partly spent by the +24% five-session run-up.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Short interest was ~27.8% of float in April 2026 (chartexchange) before the +4.42% (2026-03-19) and +2.35% (2026-05-14) reactions; the large +22%/+30% moves in 2025 came off a heavily shorted base.
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest fell only 5% into the Oct 30 settlement, before the Nov 6-9 rally, so most of the short base was still on going into the run-up; the skew already prices upside, so this is sized small.
findings.independence: Baseline skew -10.25 and put/call OI 0.5 (sealed baseline, Yahoo options) point the same way; separate data from the FINRA/Nasdaq register.

findings.finding: Fixed-price execution risk on the Q3 margin line: Q2 adj. EBITDA was -$13.8M including a $14.7M IM-4 estimate-at-completion charge, IM-3 has slipped to Q1 2027 (from H2 2026, disclosed on the Aug call), and consensus wants Q3 adj. EBITDA of ~$4.1M (B. Riley $2.2M) with ~$11M of H2 improvement needed for positive FY adj. EBITDA; another EAC adjustment on IM-3/IM-4 would put both the quarter and the FY EBITDA guide at risk.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 EAC charge (2026-08-13) came with a +3.6% close-to-close move, so the market looked through one charge once.
findings.why_not_priced: Inference, not a document: nothing public says a Q3 charge occurred; the IM-3 slip is public (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IM-3, NASA lists early 2027). Sized small accordingly.
findings.independence: Finviz/Zacks preview flags recurring cost overruns as a key risk (https://finviz.com/news/416018/intuitive-machines-must-prove-its-18-billion-backlog-can-turn-into-revenue-and-profit) - commentary, not evidence.

findings.finding: NASA selected Intuitive Machines on 2026-11-09 as one of eight awardees on the 10-year CLPS 2 IDIQ (combined ceiling ~$10B, up to $15B with extension), and JPL selected it on 2026-11-03 for the FALCON-RADAR spacecraft platform; management will fold both into the call's pipeline narrative, though neither carries a disclosed task-order value for Q3/Q4.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Stock rose ~15% on 2026-11-09 on the CLPS 2 news and ~7% on 2026-11-03 on FALCON-RADAR.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced on the day; residual is only whether management quantifies near-term task orders.

findings.finding: Financing: Q2 operating cash flow was -$59.8M and FCF -$83.9M, cash $367.4M only after ~$235M of ATM sales, long-term debt $336.4M, and a $500M ATM established June 2026 leaves roughly $265M of capacity; elevated capex for the NSN constellation is guided. The money funds a backlog ramp corroborated by the $1.8B record backlog and Q3 awards, so this signs at zero rather than as distress, though the 10-Q share count may show Q3 ATM dilution at lower prices.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured reaction to ATM disclosure at prints; the Q2 print disclosed the ATM proceeds and moved +3.6%.
findings.why_not_priced: Dilution risk is widely known (every preview flags it); the residual is only the size of Q3 ATM usage, which no source carries.
findings.independence: Q2 cash and FCF figures from https://www-web.itiger.com/news/2659817169 (2026-08-13).

outside_window.finding: IM-3 lunar landing (Nova-C, Reiner Gamma) slipped to NET Q1 2027; a mission outcome is a large binary catalyst but after the window.

Congressional funding deadline of Dec 11, 2026 has paused the push to nearly double national security space spending (Space Foundation, 2026-10-21); a lapse would hit defense/NASA contractors after the window.

baseline_tension: The skew (calls bid, -10.25), the crowded short and the +24% five-day run-up point up; the only sizeable negative I found (guide likely trimmed to the low end) cuts against them and is already public arithmetic, so I shrank it and left p_up at 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 7 (sign against strong call-side skew and a 22%-of-shares-out short): guidance negative shrunk from -2.0 to -1.5, and positioning finding raised from +0.8 to +1.0; p_up moved from 48 to 50.
Rule 5 (proxy smaller than a company number): Redwire read-across shrunk from -0.5 to -0.3; EAC-charge inference shrunk from -0.8 to -0.5.
Rule 4 (financing is a question): ATM/cash-burn finding moved from -0.3 to 0.0 because the money funds a ramp corroborated by a record backlog and Q3 awards.
Rules 1, 2, 6, 8 left the bookings (+1.5), RKLB (+0.5) and CLPS 2 (+0.3) findings unchanged; abs_move_pct unchanged at 11.
